nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory wiring auth, projects, document upload, research runs, conversations, the screening assistant, reference import, screening, extraction and exports into one API that also serves the static web UI.
nodes.languageNotes: All routes are closures inside create_app, sharing the jobs.State held on app.state rather than module globals.

nodes.name: save_pdf
nodes.summary: Streams an uploaded PDF to disk with size and magic-byte checks, returning its path and SHA-256.

nodes.name: display_name
nodes.summary: Strips path parts from an uploaded filename for display.

nodes.name: public_iteration
nodes.summary: Shapes one research-run iteration for the public API response.

nodes.name: run_out
nodes.summary: Serializes a ResearchRun row into the API response shape.

nodes.name: conversation_out
nodes.summary: Serializes a Conversation row for API responses.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Builds the FastAPI app: constructs clients and jobs.State, recovers interrupted work, and defines every auth, project, document, research, conversation, screening, extraction and export route.

nodes.name: RunIn
nodes.summary: Request model for starting a research run, validating question, conversation and web/PubMed source options.

nodes.name: DocumentOut
nodes.summary: Response model describing a document's status, chunk count and error.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Password hashing with stdlib scrypt plus HS256 JWT access-token creation and decoding for the API.

nodes.name: _derive
nodes.summary: Derives a scrypt key from a password and salt.

nodes.name: hash_password
nodes.summary: Hashes a password with a random salt using scrypt.

nodes.name: verify_password
nodes.summary: Verifies a password against a stored scrypt hash in constant time, rejecting malformed hashes.

nodes.name: create_token
nodes.summary: Creates a signed HS256 JWT for a user id with expiry.

nodes.name: decode_token
nodes.summary: Decodes and validates a JWT, returning the user id or None.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Single pydantic-settings Settings class reading .env: OpenAI models, Qdrant Cloud, web/PubMed search keys, retrieval toggles, database URL and JWT settings.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Pydantic settings model holding all environment-driven configuration for the app.

nodes.name: jobs.py
nodes.summary: Background job layer for the API: crash-isolated Docling ingestion in a child process, research runs, paper resolution, confirmed screening/extraction/full-text-fetch actions, and restart recovery.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses multiprocessing with a Pipe per job so a native Docling crash or hang kills one child process, not the server.

nodes.name: ingest_in_child
nodes.summary: Runs ingest.ingest inside the worker process with fresh clients and returns the chunk count.

nodes.name: _child_main
nodes.summary: Child-process entry that runs a function and sends its result or error back over a pipe.

nodes.name: short_error
nodes.summary: Formats an exception as a short, secret-redacted error string.

nodes.name: claim
nodes.summary: Atomically moves a row between statuses, returning False if another worker already claimed it.

nodes.name: ingest_document
nodes.summary: Claims a queued document, ingests it via the runner and records ready or failed status.

nodes.name: run_research
nodes.summary: Executes a research run: rewrites follow-ups, applies rails, resolves papers, searches PDFs/web/PubMed, runs the research loop and stores the verified result.

nodes.name: resolve_papers
nodes.summary: Routes a question to the papers it names, failing open to all ready papers.

nodes.name: screen_parse
nodes.summary: Builds the screening parser bound to the screening model.

nodes.name: screen_all
nodes.summary: Runs a confirmed screen-all pending action over the project's papers.

nodes.name: passages_for
nodes.summary: Retrieves the most relevant passages of one ingested PDF with server-side project and document filters.

nodes.name: extract_column
nodes.summary: Runs a confirmed extract-column action, extracting one value per target paper from its PDF or abstract.

nodes.name: save_fetched_pdf
nodes.summary: Stores a downloaded PDF as a project document once and queues it for ingest.

nodes.name: _fetch_one
nodes.summary: Finds and downloads a free full-text PDF for one paper, skipping candidates linked to other papers.

nodes.name: fetch_full_text
nodes.summary: Runs a confirmed fetch-full-text action, finding open-access PDFs for included papers and ingesting them.

nodes.name: conversation_history
nodes.summary: Collects earlier completed turns of a conversation as questions and verified claims.

nodes.name: recover_interrupted
nodes.summary: On startup marks in-flight documents, runs and actions as failed so they can be retried.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Dataclass bundling settings, DB sessions, Qdrant/OpenAI clients, ingest runner and executors shared by the API.

nodes.name: IngestRunner
nodes.summary: Runs each ingest in a fresh child process one at a time with timeout, crash detection and shutdown.

nodes.name: pubmed.py
nodes.summary: PubMed E-utilities client turning a question into a keyword query, fetching the newest matching abstracts and shaping them as cited research evidence.

nodes.name: keyword_query
nodes.summary: Uses the fast model to turn a question into a PubMed keyword query.

nodes.name: _text
nodes.summary: Joins the text content of an XML element.

nodes.name: _year
nodes.summary: Extracts the publication year from article XML.

nodes.name: _hit
nodes.summary: Converts one PubMed article XML element into a cited evidence hit.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Searches PubMed newest-first and fetches abstracts, returning evidence hits or raising PubMedError.

nodes.name: review_question
nodes.summary: Frames a question as a request for a literature summary.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest fixtures for API tests: fake settings, a fake ingest runner, a fake OpenAI client, an inline executor, an app/TestClient factory and user signup helper.

nodes.name: make_settings
nodes.summary: Builds test Settings with fake secrets.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Fixture creating the app with fakes and a TestClient.

nodes.name: signup
nodes.summary: Registers and logs in a test user, returning auth headers.

nodes.name: FakeRunner
nodes.summary: Fake ingest runner recording calls instead of spawning Docling.

nodes.name: InlinePool
nodes.summary: Executor that runs submitted work inline for deterministic tests.
